p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, starting a business, investment platforms: official resources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens the current official sources and then reads them in its own language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): customs duties, taxes, rules and procedures for a specific product and country in one place
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (ITC): Customs Duties and Rules of Origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labelling and health regulations for products defined by the country
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: step-by-step guide to trade to and from the EU
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: customs code and duties payable on entry into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): Starting a business, taxes, international trade, by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check that the platform is not designated by a regulator before you entrust money to it
p.espaces.rg_note: This page opens in your language: use the translator in your browser or the "Understand the document" function for a document.If you have to make a major decision, ask for advice from the expert in yo
p.espaces.cu_d: Customs, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not file a customs declaration: this can be done by a licensed customs agent (freight forwarder) on your behalf.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): obligations and rules for almost all countries
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): customs, taxes, rules of origin, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: customs code (HR code) and duties payable on entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_t4: French customs: EORI, customs clearance, simulators
p.espaces.cu_d3: Shipping document: Waybill (Sea), Air Waybill (Air), CMR (Road)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (for companies importing or exporting to the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, licence, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: buyer handles everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the goods to the buyer's carrier, under export customs clearance.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller loads the goods on the ship; the risk and costs are then borne by the buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: the seller pays the freight and insurance to the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: the seller delivers to the destination, the buyer pays the import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: the seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Forbidden or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines. Such lists are rejected and can be reported.
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr Always check the exact rules applicable to your product.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly... compare the fees for your country before sending.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money itself and does not earn any money from these links: here you compare and then send with the service of your choice.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Money transfer prices worldwide (World Bank): the real cost of sending money by country, by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash withdrawal in many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Cash withdrawal, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market rate, fees will be indicated before sending
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, cash withdrawal
p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallet, bank transfer, cash withdrawal
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to a mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Check the amount you get: fees + exchange rate A worse exchange rate than the market rate is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how you want to receive the person: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN...).
p.espaces.mt_k3: An ID is often required, both for sending and for receiving.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you’ve met online or for “unlocking” a prize, package, loan or visa: it’s almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices vary: always check their website when sending.
p.espaces.ds_d: No stock sales: find a supplier, work out a real price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that the supplier delivers directly to your customer. It's easy to get started, but you remain responsible for the sale.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is licensed in your customers’ country: no counterfeits, no regulated products without license.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier ('wholesale / supplier' listings here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the real price: product, shipping, customs, VAT of the buyer's country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Inform your customers about the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your business: business status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see Trade rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect for consumers' rights: clear prices including taxes, right of return, guarantee, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A supplier who wants to pay the full amount by unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to get rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: prohibited and punishable.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a parcel arriving from outside the EU pays VAT from the first euro.
